digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command registration
propositions: Advanced commands in bridge/reconciler/audit/workflow/identity/gate families use inline argparse construction and manual dispatch mixed with unsafe top-level help generation

Existing argparse construction must be extracted into reusable S2a side-effect-free factory contracts without importing optional runtimes like Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, or workflow executors
Parse-failure behavior must be reconciled: migrated handlers must catch RebarArgumentParser.ParseError and emit identical exit code 2 with unchanged stderr/usage bytes instead of SystemExit
Parser factories must support optional keyword passthrough for usage, add_help, and formatter_class to preserve bespoke presentation behaviors of verify, remote-cert, and nested bridge commands
Every advanced route must resolve to a valid factory reference and construct successfully without optional runtime dependencies, proven via registry-driven test matrix
Production-path tests must assert byte-identical help/usage output and unchanged exit codes, nested selection, and lean-mode availability for all migrated commands
